This page serves as a redirect to the University of Maryland Greenebaum Comprehensive Cancer Center - Flow Cytometry Shared Resources various individual GitHub repositories and learning resources.

## Cytometry in R

![](/images/WebsiteBanner.png){width="100%"}

Click [here](https://umgcccfcsr.github.io/CytometryInR/) to be redirected to our Cytometry in R course, aimed at those with prior cytometry experience but no-to-little coding experience

## InstrumentQC Dashboard

To see the current instrument QC status for the instruments at our core, navigate [here](https://umgccfcss.github.io/InstrumentQC/)

## Baltimore Introductory Spectral Flow Cytometry Course (BISCC)

For resources related to our 2025 training workshop, go [here](https://umgccfcss.github.io/BISCC_2025/)
